thresholdScene: At blue hour beneath Mount Ashigara, Kintarō stands empty-handed beside a separately planted legendary axe. A Hōju relic floats above the mountain.
relicDescription: Focus or activate the relic to reveal its shallow dimensional response. This optional interaction does not block entry.

archive.title: The Living Index
archive.introduction: Fourteen connected records form a source-conscious vertical slice. Search names, places, and motifs, or browse by entity class. Every record keeps tradition separate from original ASHIGARA canon.
archive.artNotice: Project artwork visualizes the ASHIGARA adaptation. It is not presented as historical evidence.
archive.curatorialTitle: Mountain blood. Demon roads. A living network.
archive.curatorialCopy: The index now moves between illustrated character studies and source-linked archive records. Open any chamber to see where traditional evidence ends and the project’s visual canon begins.

atlas.title: Places, Paths & Regions
atlas.introduction: This is a narrative atlas, not a claim of scientific precision. Nodes identify traditional regions and variant settings, and every certainty label stays visible.
atlas.mapLabel: Stylized map of Phase One places

chronicles.title: Chronicles
chronicles.introduction: Finite exhibitions connect records without turning the archive into an endless feed. The first path moves from mountain childhood toward the branching demon-road tradition.

about.title: Direction, System & Method
about.introduction: A concise case study of how Gate 01 turns an illustrated folklore world into an accessible, bilingual, and expandable digital archive.
about.synopsisTitle: A folklore archive entered like a lost game world.
about.synopsisCopy: ASHIGARA — The Living Archive is Gate 01 of the planned 108 Yōkai collection. Built around Mount Ashigara and the evolving traditions of Kintarō and Sakata no Kintoki, it combines a cinematic permanent threshold with illustrated, source-linked records, a narrative atlas, curated chronicles, and a modular bilingual content system.
about.quote: A lost 32 bit action world, recovered as an interactive museum.
about.briefTitle: Atmosphere with a system beneath it.
about.briefCopy: The work is held to three responsibilities: protect the authored world, make the experience legible, and let the archive grow without erasing its identity.

focusAreas.title: Creative direction
focusAreas.copy: Steven Adkins established the ASHIGARA concept, Gate system, approved visual authorities, composition locks, interaction goals, and portfolio direction. The visual language joins a recovered 32 bit action world with a restrained contemporary archive.

focusAreas.title: Experience design
focusAreas.copy: Visitors cross a cinematic threshold, then move through records, place, narrative, and method. Motion, depth, sound, and language build atmosphere without becoming requirements for navigation or understanding.

focusAreas.title: Archive system
focusAreas.copy: Folklore records, institutional sources, places, chronicles, translations, and assets live in versioned manifests. Gate 01 can expand without rebuilding the permanent entrance that gives it an identity.

about.visualCopy: Supplied masters establish character identity, palette, materials, silhouette, and composition. Runtime derivatives are optimized separately, and every original remains untouched.
about.visualHojuCopy: Hōju silhouette, material, palette, and water, flame, and ink behavior.
about.visualKintaroCopy: Anatomy, costume, material, and facial authority. This image does not define the threshold pose.
about.implementationTitle: Built for atmosphere. Structured for growth.
about.implementationCopyOne: React and TypeScript components run through Vinext and Vite. Content stays separate from views in JSON and TypeScript manifests. CSS masks, compositing, and shallow DOM planes create dimensional response without making WebGL a requirement.
about.implementationCopyTwo: A local image pipeline generates responsive AVIF and WebP derivatives while preserving the originals. A persistent English and provisional Japanese language layer covers every route, record chamber, control, label, and accessibility description. Content references, route rendering, accessibility rules, and types are checked by the validation suite.
about.statusTitle: A working first gate. The mythology is still growing.
about.statusCopy: Implemented work and future intent stay visibly separate. No unfinished feature is presented as complete.
implemented: Independent desktop and mobile threshold compositions

planned: Fluent Japanese editorial review and broader accessibility testing
Expanded reviewed records and production artwork
Final transparent character layers and approved animation sets
A separate 108 Yōkai portal connecting future independent gates

about.authorshipCopyOne: Steven defined the product, story world, approved visual references, interaction goals, composition locks, and portfolio intent.
about.authorshipCopyTwo: AI-assisted implementation supported frontend engineering, responsive styling, asset optimization, documentation, localization drafting, and structured content drafting under those constraints. AI output is not treated as a folklore source. Factual records link to institutional references, and the Japanese text remains visibly provisional pending fluent human review.
